accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged materials are available at the discretion of RAC.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The Scott B. Halstead papers is comprised of his files created, compiled, or associated with his activites for the Rockefeller Foundation. Records include: Board of Trustees, Executive Committee, and Task Force meeting records and reports, division and program files and reports, as well as President's Review and Annual Reports.

The collection also contains American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene (ASTMH) files, International Clinical Epidemiology Network (INCLEN) correspondence and meeting records, and materials pertaining to Halstead's activity as Director, Infectious Disease Research, Naval Medical Research and Development Command for the U.S Navy, as well as the civilian Naval Research Advisory Committee.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Processing Level 0 - Initial Access.

The description provided is a broad summary of contents, illuminating the scope and breadth of the available material, often of each applicable container, rather than a transcription of file titles. Additional processing will be conducted in the future to improve description, enhance access, and long-term preservation.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: The papers were donated as an unrestricted gift to Rockefeller Archive Center by Scott B. Halstead in 2018.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: The Rockefeller Archive Center has title, copyright, and literary rights in the collection, in so far as it holds them. Rockefeller Archive Center has authority to grant permission to cite and publish archival material from the collection.
